title: Dashboard: Daily/Weekly Learning Goals
description: Learning goals with progress rings. MOBILE-FIRST responsive with touch-friendly editing.

technicalContext.ui: Goal cards with circular progress indicators
technicalContext.responsive: MOBILE-FIRST: Stacked goal cards on mobile, side-by-side on desktop
technicalContext.tailwind: Use Tailwind: flex-col sm:flex-row, SVG ring animations

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create Convex schema for userGoals table
Create query to get user goals with current progress
Show goal cards with circular progress indicator (SVG ring)
Allow user to customize goal targets via settings modal
Show celebration animation/message when goal is met
Reset daily goals at midnight, weekly on Monday
MOBILE-FIRST: Stacked full-width goal cards on mobile
TAILWIND RESPONSIVE: Side-by-side goals on sm+, larger rings on lg+
UX: Tap goal to edit target, animated ring fill, confetti on completion
UI: Clean circular progress rings, percentage in center, subtle shadow
